cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Huh? The light's on in my apartment.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's odd. I'm sure I turned it off when I left.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Don't tell me a Snatcher got into your apartment too?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Searching my place? I don't keep any evidence at home.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I hear something.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Now I can hear it too.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Motion detected! Something's in there!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Right, Metal. I'm locking the front door.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Now it can't get away.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Then I'll put a charge through the blind glass. Ready?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Okay, do it!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Oh, and before that, please put what you stuffed

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: in your pocket back where it belongs.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Fine, I'll put it back. Happy now?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Then I'll open the blinds.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Whoaaaaa!

cues.speaker: Woman
cues.en: Eeek! Pervert!

cues.speaker: Woman
cues.en: Get out of here, now!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Looks like we got thrown out.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Ngh... aargh...

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You brought that on yourself.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Why, you! You were leering just as hard!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Sorry to disappoint. I have no face to leer with.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Robot's always got an excuse.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Oh, Catherine's come out.

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: Honestly, Gillian, you're such a pervert.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Ah, no, I... that was...

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: That's not very manly.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Why, you...!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Well, I'm glad Catherine's safe.

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: I was scared, so I looked up your address,

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: Gillian, and let myself in. I'm sorry. Did I startle you?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Startle me? You bet you did!

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: I'm sorry.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Ha, never mind that. But how did you get in?

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: I'm a JUNKER's daughter, you know. Picking a lock is child's play.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I see. You didn't even trip the sensors. You've got a bright future.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: And the hospital's address?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: CX district, PHC-77. The director is Chin Shu Ho, of Chinese descent.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Chin Shu Ho, huh? He's probably a Snatcher too. This is it, then.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The enemy's stronghold.

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: Gillian, be careful.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Catherine, you're safe now. They shouldn't come after you anymore.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Just to be safe, I'll have the Kobe Police guard her.

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: Gillian, I'm not mad at all about earlier.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Catherine, don't worry about us. We won't do anything reckless.

cues.speaker: Catherine
cues.en: I just... don't want to lose anyone else.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's go, Metal! To Queen Hospital!
